criteria.description: One object-family contract replaces per-variant briefs.
The run records a root seed, stable IDs, parameter hashes, and an effective contract hash.
One reusable generator is called for all selected variants.
Every selected variant is checked and one machine-readable QA report is produced.
At most one compact clarification round occurs unless the user expands the scope.
Unchanged IDs are not rebuilt after a local revision.
